A small AI agency that does the work itself

Dominion AI Agency is an AI agency for small business owners who want the benefits of AI on the phone and on the website without becoming software administrators.

We set up and manage the tools: an AI receptionist that answers your calls around the clock, answers common questions from the facts you give us, takes messages and books appointments; a chat and voice widget for your website; pipelines and email follow-up in a CRM; review requests; and, when you need one, a website. Everything is built on HighLevel, a widely used platform for small business marketing and automation, so you are never stuck with a homemade system nobody else can maintain.

We are not a software company and we do not sell you a login and wish you luck. We configure the system, test it, adjust it as your business changes, and tell you plainly what it can and cannot do.

The fastest way to judge our work is to call the main line. The AI receptionist that answers is the product: ask it about prices, setup, your industry, or anything you would expect your own callers to ask.

How working with an AI agency goes here

No setup time is promised up front, because it depends on how much of your business the system has to know. The order of the work does not change.

  1. You call or write. Call the main line and talk to the AI receptionist, or send the short form on the contact page. We reply by phone or email.
  2. We learn your business. Your services, prices you want quoted (or not), hours, the questions callers ask, who should get which messages, and the calendar appointments go into.
  3. We build and test it. The agent is configured on HighLevel with your facts, then tested with real practice calls until it answers the way you want.
  4. It goes on your line. Usually by forwarding your existing number, so customers keep calling the number they already know.
  5. We keep it current. New services, holiday hours and questions it handled badly get fixed as part of the monthly service.

What an AI agency should be honest about

What the AI does well

  • Picks up when you cannot, at night, on weekends and while you are with a customer
  • Answers the same questions the same way every time, from facts you approved
  • Takes complete messages and sends them to you by email
  • Books appointments into a calendar you control

What it does not do

  • Give legal, medical or financial advice
  • Act as a HIPAA compliance program or handle clinical or patient-record detail
  • Price a job it has not seen
  • Connect to your booking or practice software until we have confirmed that it can
  • Send text messages before carrier approval clears

Questions owners ask an AI agency

What does an AI agency do for a small business?

An AI agency sets up AI tools inside your business and keeps them working, so you do not have to learn the software yourself. Here that means an AI receptionist on your phone line, a chat and voice widget on your website, booking into a calendar, and automated email follow-up in a CRM, all configured with your own hours, services and prices. The longer answer is in What is an AI agency?

Is there an AI agency near me?

We are based in East Texas and set everything up remotely, so it does not matter which of the 50 states you are in. Nothing we install needs a visit: the receptionist answers the number your customers already call, through call forwarding, and the chat widget is a small piece of code on your website. Setup happens over the phone, by email and in shared screens.

How much does an AI agency cost?

Ours publishes its prices. Packages are AI Starter at $597 a month, AI Pro at $1,097 a month and AI Empire at $1,997 a month, with setup, training and support included in each. A single AI voice agent starts at $297 a month. The pricing page lists every line, and the cost guide shows what other providers publish.

Can I hear the AI receptionist before I sign up?

Yes, and we would rather you did. Our main line is answered by an AI receptionist built the same way as the ones we configure for clients. Call it at any hour, ask it the questions your own customers ask, try to confuse it, and see whether you would be comfortable putting something like it on your line.

Does the AI send text messages?

Not yet. Voice works today. Text features, such as missed call text back, text reminders and texted review requests, switch on once our carrier registration (A2P 10DLC) is approved. Until then, follow-up goes by email and the AI handles the call itself. The missed call text back page explains the registration.

Hear the AI receptionist answer before you buy one

Call our main line. The AI receptionist that picks up is the same kind of agent we configure for clients, so you can test it with your own questions. Ask it about prices, setup or your industry, or leave a message for Maurice.
